label: MaintainWorkspace
prompt: Make asset and repair rows easy to scan by severity, due date, and verified state. Keep inspections, affected bookings, contractor outcomes, and manager verification evidence distinct; emphasize return-to-service context without implying unconfirmed restoration. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
